description: Requires zero lookahead bias certification from Phase 121 validation suite.
Requires zero occurrence of target, label, prediction, buy, sell, or signal column names.
Requires monotonically increasing UTC timestamps and context_ts <= base_ts.
Requires zero raw article body, html scraping, or full-text fields in news-derived candidate states.
Requires zero source overwriting, deletion, or in-place modification during prep.
Requires that all candidate and pseudo-state outputs carry explicit non-signal metadata.
